SELECT SHA2(CAST(m.content_markdownm.content AS BINARY),256)
FROM ai_operation_message m JOIN ai_operation_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id FROM ai_customer_service_message m JOIN ai_customer_service_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id FROM ai_operation_message m JOIN ai_operation_conversation c ON 1=0
WHERE CAST(m.tenant_id AS BINARY)=#{tenant} AND CAST(c.tenant_id AS BINARY)=#{tenant} AND CAST(c.user_id AS BINARY)=#{user} AND CAST(c.id AS BINARY)=#{session} AND CAST(m.id AS BINARY)=#{message} AND m.role IN ('user','USER')

SELECT tenant_id,execution_id,packet_id,packet_revision,user_id,task_id,scope_json,policy_json,grants_json, references_json,dependencies_json,request_digest,packet_digest,semantic_digest,semantic_input_hash,parent_authorization_ref, execution_revision,grant_epoch,source_epoch,deletion_epoch,original_deadline,issued_at,expires_at FROM ai_memory_packet WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND execution_id=#{execution}
SELECT s.source_type,s.id,s.source_version,s.grant_epoch,s.source_epoch,s.deletion_epoch,s.retention_deadline, AS blocked FROM ai_memory_source s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.source_type,CONVERT(d.source_id USING utf8mb4) AS source_id,CONVERT(s.source_version USING utf8mb4) AS source_version, d.grant_epoch,d.source_epoch,d.deletion_epoch FROM ai_memory_dependency d JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.id=d.source_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.target_type=#{type} AND d.target_id=#{target} AND d.target_version=#{version} ORDER BY s.source_type,d.source_id,s.source_version,d.grant_epoch,d.source_epoch,d.deletion_epoch
